name: R/bundles.R
content:
# Ready-made walks: a few places walked together, mostly along one of the City of Melbourne's
# self-guided walks (data/bundles.csv, a team-made table; the core stops are planned, the extra stops
# are ideas only). On the home page they sit at the top of the places on the right and can be dragged
# into a part of a free time (R/slots.R); an empty part shows the best one as a suggestion.
#
# Each free time is split into parts (morning 8-12, afternoon 12-17, evening 17-22); a part counts if at
# least MIN_PART minutes of it are free. A walk fits a part if every core stop is open long enough
# inside the part, and the stays plus the walks between the stops (nearest-neighbour order) leave at
# least the slack free (slack_for(), R/planner.R: a quarter of the part, at least 30 minutes, for
# getting there, breaks and surprises). This is a quick screen; the day page then checks the real plan
# exactly, including the walk from the start point. Ranking among the walks that fit: the City's
# official walks first, then the team's suggested time of day, then the theme, then how quiet the
# streets by its stops are at that hour (pedestrian sensors, compared with the same streets' busiest
# hour, the way Google Maps shows "popular times").

THEMES <- c(culture = "Culture & history", nature = "Nature & gardens", views = "Views & photos",
            lanes = "Lanes, food & shopping")
THEME_ICONS <- c(culture = "🏛️", nature = "🌿", views = "📷", lanes = "☕")
PARTS <- data.frame(part = c("morning", "afternoon", "evening"), label = c("Morning", "Afternoon", "Evening"),
                    from = c(8, 12, 17) * 60, to = c(12, 17, 22) * 60)
MIN_PART <- 60

load_bundles <- function(D, file) {
  b <- read.csv(file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, na.strings = "")
  ids <- function(x) lapply(strsplit(ifelse(is.na(x), "", x), " ", fixed = TRUE), function(v) {
    i <- match(v[nzchar(v)], D$places$id)
    if (anyNA(i)) stop("unknown place in ", file, ": ", paste(v[nzchar(v)][is.na(i)], collapse = ", "))
    i
  })
  b$themes <- strsplit(b$themes, " ", fixed = TRUE)
  b$core <- ids(b$core)
  b$extra <- ids(b$extra)
  # not_before: the walk is planned to start no earlier than this (e.g. for the sunset)
  b$not_before <- vapply(b$not_before, function(x) if (is.na(x)) NA_real_ else hhmm_to_min(x), numeric(1))
  b
}

# The part as this bundle would use it: a walk with a not_before time starts no earlier than that.
bundle_part <- function(B, k, part) {
  if (!is.na(B$not_before[k])) part$t0 <- max(part$t0, B$not_before[k])
  part
}

# One row per usable part of each free time; key = "<window id>|<part>".
# Part number (1 morning, 2 afternoon, 3 evening) of time t (minutes).
part_of <- function(t) findInterval(t, c(-Inf, PARTS$to[1:2]))

window_parts <- function(ws) {
  rows <- list()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(ws))) for (j in seq_len(nrow(PARTS))) {
    a <- max(ws$t0[k], PARTS$from[j]); b <- min(ws$t1[k], PARTS$to[j])
    if (b - a >= MIN_PART) rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      key = paste(ws$id[k], PARTS$part[j], sep = "|"), window = ws$id[k], part = PARTS$part[j],
      label = PARTS$label[j], t0 = a, t1 = b, day = as.integer(format(ws$date[k], "%u")))
  }
  if (length(rows)) do.call(rbind, rows)
  else data.frame(key = character(), window = character(), part = character(), label = character(),
                  t0 = numeric(), t1 = numeric(), day = integer())
}

# Visiting order (nearest neighbour from the first stop) and minutes of stays plus walks between stops.
bundle_walk <- function(D, stops, pace = "normal") {
  p <- PACES[[pace]]
  ord <- stops[1]; left <- stops[-1]; walk <- 0
  while (length(left)) {
    d <- D$W[ord[length(ord)], left]       # places come first in D$nodes, so place index = node index
    k <- which.min(d)
    walk <- walk + d[k]; ord <- c(ord, left[k]); left <- left[-k]
  }
  list(order = ord, minutes = sum(D$places$stay_min[stops]) * p$stay + walk * p$walk)
}

bundle_fits <- function(D, stops, part, pace = "normal") fit_check(D, stops, part, pace)$status == "ok"

# Share by which the streets near these stops are quieter at `hour` than at their busiest hour
# (8-22 h) on that weekday; NA if none of the stops has a sensor nearby.
quiet_share <- function(D, stops, day, hour) {
  s <- stops[!is.na(D$places$sensor_id[stops])]
  if (length(s) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  total <- function(h) sum(D$busy[s, day, h + 1], na.rm = TRUE)
  peak <- max(vapply(8:22, total, numeric(1)))
  if (peak <= 0) NA_real_ else 1 - total(hour) / peak
}
part_hour <- function(part) floor((part$t0 + part$t1) / 2 / 60)

# Bundles (row numbers of B) for this part that fit, best first; `theme` NULL = any kind. `taken`:
# bundle ids already used in other parts; `used`: places already planned; `room`: places the free time
# can still take (at most MAX_STOPS in all).
suggest_bundles <- function(D, B, part, theme = NULL, taken = character(), pace = "normal", room = MAX_STOPS,
                            used = integer()) {
  cand <- which(!(B$id %in% taken) & lengths(B$core) <= room &
                !vapply(B$core, function(s) any(s %in% used), logical(1)))
  if (!is.null(theme)) cand <- cand[vapply(B$themes[cand], function(t) theme %in% t, logical(1))]
  cand <- cand[vapply(cand, function(k) bundle_fits(D, B$core[[k]], bundle_part(B, k, part), pace), logical(1))]
  if (length(cand) == 0) return(integer())
  q <- vapply(cand, function(k) quiet_share(D, B$core[[k]], part$day, part_hour(bundle_part(B, k, part))), numeric(1))
  score <- 3 * (!is.na(B$official_walk[cand])) +
           2 * (B$best_slot[cand] == part$part) +
           0.5 * (!is.null(theme) & vapply(cand, function(k) B$themes[[k]][1] %in% theme, logical(1))) +
           ifelse(is.na(q), 0.3, q)
  cand[order(-score)]
}

bundle_reason <- function(D, B, k, part) {
  part <- bundle_part(B, k, part)
  h <- part_hour(part)
  q <- quiet_share(D, B$core[[k]], part$day, h)
  crowd <- if (is.na(q)) "" else if (q >= 0.05)
    sprintf(tr(" Around %s on a %s the streets by these stops are %d%% quieter than at their busiest hour."),
            fmt_time(h * 60), day_name(part$day, "full"), round(100 * q))
  else sprintf(tr(" Around %s is about the busiest hour on these streets on a %s."), fmt_time(h * 60),
               day_name(part$day, "full"))
  paste0(bundle_idea(B, k), crowd)
}

name: R/calendar.R
content:
# Free time from a calendar file.
# Visitors export their calendar as .ics (Apple Calendar, Google Calendar and Outlook all can).
# The file is read in this R session only; nothing is uploaded anywhere.

TZ <- "Australia/Melbourne"

# Minimal iCalendar reader: VEVENT start, end, summary and location.
parse_ics <- function(path) {
  raw <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  raw <- sub("\r$", "", raw)
  # unfold continuation lines (RFC 5545: a line starting with a space or tab continues the previous one)
  grp <- cumsum(!grepl("^[ \t]", raw))
  lines <- unname(tapply(sub("^[ \t]", "", raw), grp, paste, collapse = ""))
  starts <- which(lines == "BEGIN:VEVENT"); ends <- which(lines == "END:VEVENT")
  if (length(starts) == 0) return(empty_events())
  unescape <- function(v) gsub("\\\\([,;\\\\])", "\\1", gsub("\\\\[nN]", " ", v))
  ev <- lapply(seq_along(starts), function(k) {
    block <- lines[(starts[k] + 1):(ends[k] - 1)]
    key <- toupper(sub("[;:].*$", "", block))
    params <- ifelse(grepl("^[^:]*;", block), sub("^[^;]*;([^:]*):.*$", "\\1", block), "")
    value <- sub("^[^:]*:", "", block)
    get <- function(k) if (any(key == k)) list(value = value[key == k][1], params = params[key == k][1]) else NULL
    s <- get("DTSTART"); e <- get("DTEND")
    if (is.null(s)) return(NULL)
    st <- ics_time(s$value, s$params)
    en <- if (is.null(e)) st + ifelse(attr(st, "allday"), 86400, 3600) else ics_time(e$value, e$params)
    data.frame(start = as.POSIXct(st), end = as.POSIXct(en), allday = isTRUE(attr(st, "allday")),
               summary = unescape(if (is.null(get("SUMMARY"))) "" else get("SUMMARY")$value),
               location = unescape(if (is.null(get("LOCATION"))) "" else get("LOCATION")$value))
  })
  ev <- do.call(rbind, ev)
  if (is.null(ev)) return(empty_events())
  attr(ev$start, "tzone") <- TZ; attr(ev$end, "tzone") <- TZ
  ev[order(ev$start), ]
}

empty_events <- function() {
  data.frame(start = as.POSIXct(character(), tz = TZ), end = as.POSIXct(character(), tz = TZ),
             allday = logical(), summary = character(), location = character())
}

# "20261104T090000", "20261103T220000Z" (UTC) or "20261104" with VALUE=DATE (all day).
ics_time <- function(v, params) {
  allday <- grepl("VALUE=DATE(;|$)", params) || nchar(v) == 8
  if (allday) {
    t <- as.POSIXct(paste0(v, "000000"), format = "%Y%m%d%H%M%S", tz = TZ)
  } else if (grepl("Z$", v)) {
    t <- as.POSIXct(sub("Z$", "", v), format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = "UTC")
  } else {
    tz <- sub("^.*TZID=([^;]*).*$", "\\1", params)
    if (!nzchar(tz) || tz == params || !(tz %in% OlsonNames())) tz <- TZ
    t <- as.POSIXct(v, format = "%Y%m%dT%H%M%S", tz = tz)
  }
  attr(t, "tzone") <- TZ
  attr(t, "allday") <- allday
  t
}

# Match a calendar location ("Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre, ...") to a start point or place.
match_location <- function(loc, D) {
  if (!nzchar(loc)) return(NA_character_)
  l <- tolower(loc)
  keys <- list(mcec = c("convention", "exhibition centre", "mcec"),
               southern_cross = c("southern cross", "skybus", "spencer st"),
               flinders_st_stn = c("flinders street station", "flinders st station"),
               melb_central_stn = c("melbourne central"),
               parliament_stn = c("parliament station"))
  for (id in names(keys)) if (any(vapply(keys[[id]], grepl, logical(1), x = l, fixed = TRUE))) return(id)
  hit <- which(vapply(tolower(D$places$name), function(n) grepl(n, l, fixed = TRUE), logical(1)))
  if (length(hit)) return(D$places$id[hit[1]])
  NA_character_
}

# Free windows on each date between day_start and day_end that are not covered by a timed event.
# base_t0 / base_start keep where and when the free time really starts; t0 / start can move later
# when the visitor takes a rest first (rest = minutes, spent at the place they are staying).
# Each window starts where the previous event was (or at the home base) and must end where the
# next event is (or back at the home base), with `buffer` minutes kept clear around events.
free_windows <- function(ev, dates, D, home = "southern_cross", day_start = 8 * 60, day_end = 21 * 60,
                         min_len = 90, buffer = 15) {
  out <- list()
  for (d in as.character(dates)) {
    day0 <- as.POSIXct(paste(d, "00:00:00"), tz = TZ)
    e <- ev[!ev$allday & ev$end > day0 & ev$start < day0 + 86400, ]
    s <- pmax(0, as.numeric(difftime(e$start, day0, units = "mins")) - buffer)
    f <- pmin(1440, as.numeric(difftime(e$end, day0, units = "mins")) + buffer)
    cur <- day_start; prev_loc <- home
    ord <- order(s)
    for (k in c(ord, NA)) {
      nxt_s <- if (is.na(k)) day_end else s[k]
      nxt_loc <- if (is.na(k)) home else { m <- match_location(e$location[k], D); if (is.na(m)) home else m }
      if (min(nxt_s, day_end) - cur >= min_len)
        out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.frame(date = as.Date(d), t0 = cur, t1 = min(nxt_s, day_end),
                                             start = prev_loc, end = nxt_loc, source = "calendar")
      if (!is.na(k)) {
        cur <- max(cur, f[k])
        m <- match_location(e$location[k], D)
        prev_loc <- if (is.na(m)) home else m
      }
      if (cur >= day_end) break
    }
  }
  if (length(out) == 0) return(empty_windows())
  w <- do.call(rbind, out)
  w$t0 <- ceiling(w$t0 / 15) * 15; w$t1 <- floor(w$t1 / 15) * 15     # tidy to quarter hours
  w <- w[w$t1 - w$t0 >= min_len, ]
  w$id <- sprintf("w%d", seq_len(nrow(w)))
  w$base_t0 <- w$t0; w$base_start <- w$start; w$rest <- 0
  w[, c("id", "date", "t0", "t1", "start", "end", "source", "base_t0", "base_start", "rest")]
}

empty_windows <- function() {
  data.frame(id = character(), date = as.Date(character()), t0 = numeric(), t1 = numeric(),
             start = character(), end = character(), source = character(),
             base_t0 = numeric(), base_start = character(), rest = numeric())
}

window_label <- function(w, short = FALSE) {
  day <- fmt_date(w$date, if (short) "%a %e %b" else "%A %e %B")
  sprintf("%s · %s–%s", gsub("  ", " ", day), fmt_time(w$t0), fmt_time(w$t1))
}

# Export the plan as an iCalendar file: one event per stop, at the times of the shortest-walk order
# of each free time (Melbourne local time). Returns the lines; write them with CRLF line ends.
plan_ics <- function(windows, day_sel, D, pace = "normal") {
  esc <- function(v) gsub("\n", "\\\\n", gsub("([,;\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", v))
  stamp <- function(date, m) sprintf("%sT%02d%02d00", format(date, "%Y%m%d"), as.integer(m %/% 60), as.integer(round(m %% 60)))
  now <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ", tz = "UTC")
  ev <- character()
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(windows))) {
    w <- windows[k, ]
    ids <- day_sel[[w$id]]
    if (length(ids) == 0) next
    cx <- make_window_ctx(D, w, pace)
    opt <- plan_trip(match(ids, D$places$id), cx)$options$shortest
    for (j in seq_along(opt$order)) {
      i <- opt$order[j]
      t0 <- round(opt$start[j]); t1 <- round(opt$end[j])
      ev <- c(ev, "BEGIN:VEVENT",
              sprintf("UID:%s-%s-%s@melbourne-in-n-hours", format(w$date, "%Y%m%d"), w$id, D$places$id[i]),
              paste0("DTSTAMP:", now),
              paste0("DTSTART;TZID=Australia/Melbourne:", stamp(w$date, t0)),
              paste0("DTEND;TZID=Australia/Melbourne:", stamp(w$date, t1)),
              paste0("SUMMARY:", esc(sprintf("%d. %s", j, place_name(D, i)))),
              # LOCATION stays the English name: calendar apps look it up on their maps.
              paste0("LOCATION:", esc(paste(D$places$name[i], "Melbourne VIC", sep = ", "))),
              sprintf("GEO:%.6f;%.6f", D$places$lat[i], D$places$lon[i]),
              paste0("DESCRIPTION:", esc(sprintf(tr("Stop %d of %d. About %d min walk from %s. Planned with Melbourne in N Hours."),
                                                 j, length(opt$order), round(opt$walk_in[j]),
                                                 if (j == 1) tr("where you set off") else tr("the previous stop")))),
              "END:VEVENT")
    }
  }
  c("BEGIN:VCALENDAR", "VERSION:2.0", "PRODID:-//GEOM90007 Group 24//Melbourne in N Hours//EN", "CALSCALE:GREGORIAN",
    "X-WR-TIMEZONE:Australia/Melbourne", ev, "END:VCALENDAR")
}

name: R/data.R
R/effort.R
content:
# "About how long, how tiring": the time and the steps on foot of one place, a walk or a whole plan.
#
# Time = the suggested stay at each place (stay_min, a team assumption, scaled by the pace setting)
# plus the walks between the stops (Vicmap network).
# Effort = steps on foot: the walks between the stops plus walking inside each place. Inside a place
# we assume an on-foot pace by the kind of visit (team assumptions): strolling outdoors in a park or
# along the river 3 km/h, browsing lanes, shops and markets 2 km/h, looking at exhibits and
# buildings 1.5 km/h. Steps = km x 1,300 (a stride of about 0.77 m).
# Levels are set against the familiar 10,000 steps a day: one place under 1,500 steps is easy and
# 3,000 or more is tiring; an outing (a walk or a free time) under 4,000 is easy and 8,000 or more
# is tiring.

STEPS_PER_KM <- 1300
EFFORT_LABELS <- c("Easy", "Medium", "Tiring")
EFFORT_CUTS <- list(place = c(1500, 3000), outing = c(4000, 8000))

inside_kmh <- function(places) {
  stroll <- places$category == "Parks & gardens" |
            (places$category == "Views & attractions" & places$setting == "outdoor")
  ifelse(stroll, 3, ifelse(places$category %in% c("Laneways & shopping", "Markets & food"), 2, 1.5))
}

# Metres on foot inside each place during its stay.
inside_m <- function(D, i, pace = "normal") {
  D$places$stay_min[i] * PACES[[pace]]$stay / 60 * inside_kmh(D$places[i, , drop = FALSE]) * 1000
}

# Minutes and steps of visiting `stops` in this order, with the walks between them; `from` / `to`
# (node ids) add the walk from a start point and back to an end point.
outing_effort <- function(D, stops, pace = "normal", from = NULL, to = NULL) {
  ids <- c(from, D$places$id[stops], to)
  k <- match(ids, D$nodes)
  legs <- if (length(k) > 1) cbind(k[-length(k)], k[-1]) else matrix(0L, 0, 2)
  walk_m <- sum(D$M[legs]); walk_min <- sum(D$W[legs]) * PACES[[pace]]$walk
  list(minutes = sum(D$places$stay_min[stops]) * PACES[[pace]]$stay + walk_min,
       walk_m = walk_m, steps = (walk_m + sum(inside_m(D, stops, pace))) / 1000 * STEPS_PER_KM)
}

effort_level <- function(steps, kind = "outing") 1L + findInterval(steps, EFFORT_CUTS[[kind]])

# Round for display: to 100 steps for one place, to 500 for an outing. In the current language (tr()).
fmt_steps <- function(steps, kind = "outing") {
  r <- if (kind == "place") 100 else 500
  sprintf(tr("≈ %s steps"), format(max(r, round(steps / r) * r), big.mark = ","))
}

# Small three-bar meter with the level and the steps, e.g. "▮▮▯ Medium · ≈ 6,000 steps".
# `what`: what the steps include, for the tooltip (English; translated here, so callers may pass
# either the English text or an already translated one).
effort_tag <- function(steps, kind = "outing", steps_text = TRUE,
                       what = if (kind == "place") tr("walking about inside") else tr("walking between the stops and inside them")) {
  lv <- effort_level(steps, kind)
  htmltools::span(class = paste0("effort e", lv),
    title = sprintf(tr("%s on foot (%s). Easy under %s, tiring from %s steps."),
                    fmt_steps(steps, kind), tr(what), format(EFFORT_CUTS[[kind]][1], big.mark = ","),
                    format(EFFORT_CUTS[[kind]][2], big.mark = ",")),
    htmltools::tags$i(htmltools::tags$b(), htmltools::tags$b(), htmltools::tags$b()),
    tr(EFFORT_LABELS[lv]), if (steps_text) htmltools::tags$small(fmt_steps(steps, kind)))
}

# Sentence for the card above the overview: everything planned over the trip.
trip_total <- function(sums) {
  if (length(sums) == 0) return(NULL)
  m <- sum(vapply(sums, function(x) x$minutes, numeric(1))); st <- sum(vapply(sums, function(x) x$steps, numeric(1)))
  htmltools::span(class = "trip-total", sprintf(tr(" Planned so far: %s on the go, %s."), fmt_dur(m), fmt_steps(st)))
}

name: R/i18n.R
content:
# Two languages for the interface: English (the default) and Chinese, switched in Trip settings
# (input$lang). The code itself stays in English; the Chinese lives in data/i18n/:
#   zh_names.csv  places, stations, walks and official walk names (kind, key, zh)
#   zh_ui*.csv    every interface text, keyed by its English text (en, zh). For a sentence with
#                 numbers or names the key is the sprintf template itself, so the Chinese template
#                 must have the same placeholders (use %1$s, %2$s to put them in another order).
# tools/check_i18n.py checks that every literal passed to tr() has a Chinese entry with the same
# placeholders.
#
# tr() finds the language from the session it runs in (shiny's reactive domain) and reads
# input$lang there, so every output or observer that uses it is redrawn when the language changes.
# Outside a session (start-up code) it gives the English text. Static parts of the page (built once)
# use i18n(), which www/app.js swaps on the page.

load_i18n <- function(dir = "data/i18n") {
  files <- list.files(dir, "^zh_ui.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  ui <- do.call(rbind, lapply(files, function(f) read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")))
  ui <- ui[!duplicated(ui$en), ]
  nm <- read.csv(file.path(dir, "zh_names.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  list(ui = setNames(ui$zh, ui$en), names = setNames(nm$zh, paste(nm$kind, nm$key, sep = "|")))
}
I18N <- load_i18n()

cur_lang <- function() {
  dom <- shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
  if (is.null(dom)) return("en")
  l <- tryCatch(dom$input$lang, error = function(e) NULL)
  if (identical(l, "zh")) "zh" else "en"
}
is_zh <- function() cur_lang() == "zh"

# English text (or sprintf template) -> the current language; vectorised.
tr <- function(s) {
  if (!is_zh()) return(s)
  z <- unname(I18N$ui[s])
  ifelse(is.na(z), s, z)
}
# Plural "s" of English words ("3 place%s"); nothing in Chinese.
pl <- function(n) if (!is_zh() && n != 1) "s" else ""

# Names from the data in the current language.
zh_name <- function(kind, key, en) {
  if (!is_zh()) return(en)
  z <- unname(I18N$names[paste(kind, key, sep = "|")])
  ifelse(is.na(z), en, z)
}
place_name <- function(D, i) zh_name("place", D$places$id[i], D$places$name[i])
start_name <- function(D, id) zh_name("start", id, D$starts$name[match(id, D$starts$id)])
bundle_name <- function(B, k) zh_name("bundle_name", B$id[k], B$name[k])
bundle_idea <- function(B, k) zh_name("bundle_idea", B$id[k], B$idea[k])
official_walk_name <- function(x) zh_name("official_walk", x, x)

# Weekday i (1 = Monday): "Monday" (full), "Mon" (short) or "Mondays" (plural), in the current language.
day_name <- function(i, form = "full") {
  en <- DAY_LABELS[i]
  tr(switch(form, full = en, short = substr(en, 1, 3), plural = paste0(en, "s")))
}
# Dates in the few formats the interface uses: "%a %e %b" (Wed 4 Nov), "%A %e %B" (Wednesday 4
# November), "%e %b" (4 Nov), "%a" and "%A".
fmt_date <- function(d, f = "%a %e %b") {
  if (!is_zh()) return(trimws(format(d, f)))
  wd <- as.integer(format(d, "%u"))
  md <- sprintf(tr("DATE %d/%d"), as.integer(format(d, "%m")), as.integer(format(d, "%d")))
  switch(f,
    "%a %e %b" = paste(md, day_name(wd, "short")),
    "%A %e %B" = paste(md, day_name(wd, "full")),
    "%e %b" = md,
    "%a" = day_name(wd, "short"),
    "%A" = day_name(wd, "full"),
    trimws(format(d, f)))
}

# A piece of the static page (built once) in the current language: English in the page, swapped by
# www/app.js when the language changes. `key` tells apart the same English word used for different
# things (e.g. "From" a time and "From" a place).
i18n <- function(s, key = s) htmltools::span(`data-i18n` = key, `data-en` = s, s)

name: R/overview.R
content:
# Home page, three columns: the ready-made walks on the left, the days in the middle (one row per day
# of the trip, split into morning, afternoon and evening), every single place on the right. A walk or a
# place is dragged from either side into a part of a day (or + picks one, R/slots.R). Only places are
# decided here; the order and the route come on each day's page.
# While something is dragged, the parts it fits turn green (amber if it would leave little time free)
# and the parts where it is closed or too long fade (www/app.js).
#
# Each day row has a thin time strip on the same 8-22 h axis as its three columns (4:5:5, as long as
# the parts): the free time as a white bar whose two ends can be dragged to change it (www/app.js), the
# city's street busyness by hour underneath (orange), sunset (dashed line) and where the parts meet
# (12:00 and 17:00, fixed: a day's routine).

hours_text <- function(o, cl) {
  if (is.na(o)) return(tr("Closed"))
  if (o == 0 && cl == 1440) return(tr("Open all day"))
  sprintf("%s–%s", sub(":00$", "", fmt_time(o)), sub(":00$", "", fmt_time(cl)))
}

DAY_LO <- 8 * 60
DAY_HI <- 22 * 60
pct <- function(t) sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * (min(max(t, DAY_LO), DAY_HI) - DAY_LO) / (DAY_HI - DAY_LO))
pct_w <- function(a, b) sprintf("%.2f%%", 100 * max(0, min(b, DAY_HI) - max(a, DAY_LO)) / (DAY_HI - DAY_LO))

# Opening hours of place i on each day of the trip, for its tooltip.
trip_hours <- function(D, i, dates) {
  paste(vapply(dates, function(d) {
    wd <- as.integer(format(d, "%u"))
    sprintf("%s %s", fmt_date(d, "%a"), hours_text(D$open[i, wd], D$close[i, wd]))
  }, character(1)), collapse = " · ")
}

drag_attrs <- function(item, fit, from = NULL) {
  list(draggable = "true", `data-item` = item, `data-fit` = as.character(jsonlite::toJSON(as.list(fit), auto_unbox = TRUE)),
       `data-from` = from)
}

# One place in a slot: name, about how long, how tiring; drag it to another part, × takes it out.
slot_chip <- function(D, i, key, fit, pace) {
  p <- D$places[i, ]
  do.call(htmltools::div, c(list(class = "slot-chip", title = tr("Drag to another part of a day, or × to take it out")),
    drag_attrs(paste0("place:", p$id), fit, key),
    list(htmltools::strong(place_name(D, i)),
         htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("~%s"), fmt_dur(p$stay_min * PACES[[pace]]$stay))),
         effort_tag(inside_m(D, i, pace) / 1000 * STEPS_PER_KM, "place", steps_text = FALSE),
         htmltools::tags$button(class = "chip-x", title = tr("Take it out"), onclick = js_input("slot_remove", p$id), "×"))))
}

slot_box <- function(D, B, part, slots, walks, sugg, fits, pace) {
  key <- part$key
  ids <- slots[[key]] %||% character()
  idx <- match(ids, D$places$id)
  w <- walks[[key]]
  shown <- part                                  # a walk with a start time (the sunset one) uses the part from then
  if (!is.null(w)) part <- bundle_part(B, match(w, B$id), part)
  len <- part$t1 - part$t0
  chk <- fit_check(D, idx, part, pace)
  used <- if (length(idx) && !is.na(chk$minutes)) chk$minutes else if (length(idx)) bundle_walk(D, idx, pace)$minutes else 0
  free <- len - used
  state <- if (!length(idx)) "empty" else if (chk$status == "no") "over" else if (chk$status == "tight") "tight" else "ok"
  sg <- sugg[[key]]
  htmltools::div(class = paste("slot", state), `data-slot` = key,
    htmltools::div(class = "slot-head",
      htmltools::strong(tr(part$label)),
      htmltools::span(sprintf("%s–%s", fmt_time(shown$t0), fmt_time(shown$t1)))),
    htmltools::div(class = "slot-meter", title = sprintf(tr("Planned about %s of %s; we keep at least %s free"),
                                                        fmt_dur(used), fmt_dur(len), fmt_dur(slack_for(len))),
      htmltools::tags$i(htmltools::tags$b(style = sprintf("width:%.1f%%", min(100, 100 * used / len))),
                        htmltools::tags$u(style = sprintf("left:%.1f%%", 100 * (len - slack_for(len)) / len))),
      htmltools::tags$small(if (!length(idx)) sprintf(tr("%s free"), fmt_dur(len))
                            else if (state == "over") (if (nzchar(chk$why) && is.na(chk$minutes)) chk$why else sprintf(tr("Over by %s"), fmt_dur(-free)))
                            else if (state == "tight") sprintf(tr("Tight: %s free"), fmt_dur(free))
                            else sprintf(tr("%s free"), fmt_dur(free)))),
    if (!is.null(w)) { k <- match(w, B$id)
      htmltools::div(class = "slot-walk",
        htmltools::span(if (is.na(B$official_walk[k])) tr("Team-made walk") else sprintf(tr("City walk: %s"), official_walk_name(B$official_walk[k]))),
        htmltools::strong(bundle_name(B, k)),
        htmltools::tags$button(class = "chip-x", title = tr("Clear this part"), onclick = js_input("slot_clear", key), "×"),
        if (part$t0 > shown$t0) htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("Starts around %s"), fmt_time(part$t0)))) },
    if (length(idx)) htmltools::div(class = "slot-items",
      lapply(idx, function(i) slot_chip(D, i, key, fits$place[[D$places$id[i]]], pace)),
      effort_tag(outing_effort(D, bundle_walk(D, idx, pace)$order, pace)$steps))
    else if (!is.null(sg)) {
      bw <- bundle_walk(D, B$core[[sg]], pace); ef <- outing_effort(D, bw$order, pace)
      htmltools::div(class = "slot-suggest", title = bundle_reason(D, B, sg, part),
        htmltools::tags$small(if (is.na(B$official_walk[sg])) tr("Suggested · team-made walk") else tr("Suggested · City walk")),
        htmltools::strong(bundle_name(B, sg)),
        htmltools::span(paste(place_name(D, bw$order), collapse = " → ")),
        htmltools::div(class = "slot-suggest-foot",   # "About %1$s": a duration (see place_card)
          htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("About %1$s"), fmt_dur(ef$minutes))), effort_tag(ef$steps, steps_text = FALSE),
          htmltools::tags$button(class = "btn primary", onclick = js_input("take_suggestion", key), tr("Take"))))
    }
    else htmltools::p(class = "slot-hint", tr("Drop a walk or a place here")))
}

day_row <- function(D, B, d, ws, parts, slots, walks, sugg, fits, sums, busy, pace) {
  k <- which(ws$date == d)
  wd <- as.integer(format(d, "%u"))
  sm <- Filter(Negate(is.null), sums[ws$id[k]])
  sun <- sunset_min(d)
  any_ids <- unlist(lapply(ws$id[k], function(id) slots[[slot_key(id, SLOT_ANY)]]), use.names = FALSE)
  # one white bar per free time, with a dot at each end to drag it longer or shorter (in quarter
  # hours, at least 30 minutes long, not into the free time before or after it that day)
  ends <- function(j) {
    prev <- max(c(DAY_LO, ws$t1[k][ws$t1[k] <= ws$t0[j]]))
    nxt <- min(c(DAY_HI, ws$t0[k][ws$t0[k] >= ws$t1[j]]))
    lapply(c("t0", "t1"), function(f) {
      t <- ws[[f]][j]
      lim <- if (f == "t0") c(prev, ws$t1[j] - 30) else c(ws$t0[j] + 30, nxt)
      htmltools::tags$button(class = paste("free-handle", f), `data-wid` = ws$id[j], `data-field` = f, `data-t` = t,
        `data-min` = lim[1], `data-max` = lim[2], style = sprintf("left:%s", pct(t)),
        title = sprintf(if (f == "t0") tr("Drag to change when this free time starts (now %s)")
                        else tr("Drag to change when this free time ends (now %s)"), fmt_time(t)),
        `aria-label` = sprintf(if (f == "t0") tr("Free time starts on %s: %s") else tr("Free time ends on %s: %s"),
                               fmt_date(d, "%A"), fmt_time(t)),
        htmltools::tags$em(fmt_time(t)))
    })
  }
  strip <- htmltools::div(class = "day-strip",
    lapply(c(PARTS$to[1:2]), function(t) htmltools::tags$i(class = "strip-split", style = sprintf("left:%s", pct(t)))),
    lapply(k, function(j) htmltools::tags$i(class = "strip-free", `data-wid` = ws$id[j],
      style = sprintf("left:%s; width:%s", pct(ws$t0[j]), pct_w(ws$t0[j], ws$t1[j])),
      title = sprintf(tr("Free %s–%s"), fmt_time(ws$t0[j]), fmt_time(ws$t1[j])))),
    htmltools::div(class = "strip-band", lapply(seq(DAY_LO, DAY_HI - 60, by = 60), function(h)
      htmltools::tags$i(class = paste0("lv", busy$level[wd, h / 60 + 1]), style = sprintf("left:%s; width:%s", pct(h), pct_w(h, h + 60)),
                        title = sprintf(tr("%s %02d:00 · about %s people/h on the streets near our places"), day_name(wd), h / 60,
                                        format(round(busy$count[wd, h / 60 + 1], -1), big.mark = ","))))),
    if (sun > DAY_LO && sun < DAY_HI) htmltools::tags$i(class = "strip-sun", style = sprintf("left:%s", pct(sun)),
                                                         title = sprintf(tr("Sunset about %s"), fmt_time(sun))),
    lapply(k, ends))
  cols <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(PARTS)), function(j) {
    here <- parts[parts$window %in% ws$id[k] & parts$part == PARTS$part[j], ]
    htmltools::div(class = "day-col",
      if (nrow(here)) lapply(seq_len(nrow(here)), function(r) slot_box(D, B, here[r, ], slots, walks, sugg, fits, pace))
      else htmltools::div(class = "slot none", htmltools::span(tr(PARTS$label[j])), htmltools::tags$small(tr("Not free"))))
  })
  htmltools::div(class = "day-row",
    htmltools::div(class = "day-label",
      htmltools::strong(fmt_date(d, "%a %e %b")),
      htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("%s free"), fmt_dur(sum(ws$t1[k] - ws$t0[k])))),
      if (length(sm)) htmltools::tagList(
        htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("%s on the go"), fmt_dur(sum(vapply(sm, function(x) x$minutes, numeric(1)))))),
        effort_tag(sum(vapply(sm, function(x) x$steps, numeric(1))), what = tr("from your start, the stops and back"))),
      lapply(k, function(j) htmltools::div(class = "day-buttons",
        htmltools::tags$button(class = "day-open", onclick = js_input("goto", ws$id[j]),
          title = tr("Open this free time: order, times and route"),
          if (length(k) > 1) sprintf(tr("Open %s–%s ›"), fmt_time(ws$t0[j]), fmt_time(ws$t1[j])) else tr("Open day ›")),
        htmltools::tags$button(class = "day-gear", title = tr("Change this free time"),
                               onclick = sprintf("openFreeTimes('%s')", ws$id[j]), ICON$gear)))),
    htmltools::div(class = "day-track", strip, htmltools::div(class = "day-cols", cols),
      if (length(any_ids)) htmltools::div(class = "day-any", htmltools::tags$small(tr("Added on the day page:")),
        lapply(match(any_ids, D$places$id), function(i) slot_chip(D, i, where_planned(slots, D$places$id[i]),
                                                                  fits$place[[D$places$id[i]]], pace)))))
}

pool_ui <- function(D, B, ws, parts, slots, walks, fits, pace) {
  dates <- sort(unique(ws$date))
  part_name <- function(key) {
    w <- ws[ws$id == slot_window(key), ]
    lab <- if (slot_part(key) == SLOT_ANY) "" else paste0(" ", tr(tolower(PARTS$label[match(slot_part(key), PARTS$part)])))
    paste0(fmt_date(w$date, "%a"), lab)
  }
  flag <- function(x) if (x) "1" else "0"
  walk_item <- function(k) {
    core <- B$core[[k]]
    bw <- bundle_walk(D, core, pace); ef <- outing_effort(D, bw$order, pace)
    fit <- fits$walk[[B$id[k]]]
    at <- names(walks)[vapply(walks, function(x) identical(x, B$id[k]), logical(1))]
    nowhere <- !any(fit %in% c("ok", "tight"))
    do.call(htmltools::div, c(list(class = paste("pool-item pool-walk", if (length(at)) "planned", if (nowhere) "nowhere"),
                                   `data-indoor` = flag(all(D$places$setting[core] == "indoor")),
                                   `data-free` = flag(all(grepl("^free", D$places$entry[core]))),
                                   title = paste0(bundle_idea(B, k), if (nowhere) tr(" It does not fit any part of your free time.") else "")),
      drag_attrs(paste0("walk:", B$id[k]), fit),
      list(htmltools::div(class = "pool-main",
             htmltools::div(htmltools::strong(bundle_name(B, k)),
               htmltools::span(class = "walk-tag", if (is.na(B$official_walk[k])) tr("Team-made") else tr("City walk")),
               if (length(at)) htmltools::span(class = "at-tag", sprintf(tr("In %s"), part_name(at[1])))),
             htmltools::tags$small(class = "pool-stops", paste(place_name(D, bw$order), collapse = " · ")),
             htmltools::div(class = "pool-facts",
               htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(tr("About %s · best in the %s"), fmt_dur(ef$minutes), tr(B$best_slot[k]))),
               effort_tag(ef$steps, steps_text = FALSE))),
           htmltools::tags$button(class = "add", title = tr("Add it to a good part of your free time"),
                                  onclick = js_input("slot_add", paste0("walk:", B$id[k])), "+"))))
  }
  place_item <- function(i) {
    p <- D$places[i, ]
    fit <- fits$place[[p$id]]
    at <- where_planned(slots, p$id)
    nowhere <- !any(fit %in% c("ok", "tight", "here"))
    do.call(htmltools::div, c(list(class = paste("pool-item pool-place", if (!is.na(at)) "planned", if (nowhere) "nowhere"),
                                   `data-indoor` = flag(p$setting == "indoor"), `data-free` = flag(grepl("^free", p$entry)),
                                   title = paste0(trip_hours(D, i, dates), if (nowhere) paste0("\n", tr("Not open long enough in any of your free times")) else "")),
      drag_attrs(paste0("place:", p$id), fit, if (!is.na(at)) at),
      list(htmltools::div(class = "pool-main",
             htmltools::div(htmltools::strong(place_name(D, i)), if (!is.na(at)) htmltools::span(class = "at-tag", part_name(at))),
             htmltools::div(class = "pool-facts",
               htmltools::tags$small(sprintf("%s · %s · %s", sprintf(tr("~%s"), fmt_dur(p$stay_min * PACES[[pace]]$stay)),
                                             tr(p$setting), tr(p$entry))),
               effort_tag(inside_m(D, i, pace) / 1000 * STEPS_PER_KM, "place", steps_text = FALSE))),
           htmltools::tags$button(class = "add", title = if (!is.na(at)) tr("Take it out") else tr("Add it to a good part of your free time"),
                                  onclick = if (!is.na(at)) js_input("slot_remove", p$id) else js_input("slot_add", paste0("place:", p$id)),
                                  if (!is.na(at)) "×" else "+"))))
  }
  # what fits somewhere first, what fits nowhere in this trip last (the places in their own group)
  fits_any <- function(fit) any(fit %in% c("ok", "tight", "here"))
  walk_fit <- vapply(B$id, function(id) fits_any(fits$walk[[id]]), logical(1))
  place_fit <- vapply(D$places$id, function(id) fits_any(fits$place[[id]]), logical(1))
  walk_order <- order(!walk_fit, is.na(B$official_walk), match(B$best_slot, PARTS$part))
  filters <- htmltools::div(class = "pool-filters",
    htmltools::tags$button(`data-filter` = "indoor", onclick = "togglePoolFilter(this)", tr("Indoor only")),
    htmltools::tags$button(`data-filter` = "free", onclick = "togglePoolFilter(this)", tr("Free entry")))
  # two columns either side of the days: the ready-made walks (left) and every single place (right);
  # both can be dragged from, and dropping a place back on either takes it out of the plan
  list(
    walks = htmltools::tags$aside(class = "pool pool-walks", `data-drop` = "pool",
      htmltools::div(class = "pool-head",
        htmltools::h2(tr("Ready-made walks")),
        htmltools::p(tr("A few places that go well together, most of them the City of Melbourne's own self-guided walks. Drag one into a part of a day, or press +.")),
        filters),
      htmltools::div(class = "pool-body", lapply(walk_order, walk_item))),
    places = htmltools::tags$aside(class = "pool pool-places", `data-drop` = "pool",
      htmltools::div(class = "pool-head",
        htmltools::h2(tr("Places")),
        htmltools::p(tr("Every place we know, to add one by one. Hover for its opening hours on your days.")),
        filters),
      htmltools::div(class = "pool-body",
        lapply(CATEGORY_ORDER, function(cat) {
          idx <- which(D$places$category == cat & place_fit)
          if (length(idx)) htmltools::tagList(htmltools::h3(tr(cat)), lapply(idx, place_item))
        }),
        if (any(!place_fit)) htmltools::tagList(htmltools::h3(tr("Not open in any of your free times")),
                                                lapply(which(!place_fit), place_item)))))
}

# `bar`: the card about where the free times come from (built in app.R).
home_ui <- function(D, B, ws, parts, slots, walks, sugg, fits, sums, busy, pace, bar = NULL) {
  head <- htmltools::div(class = "page-title",

            htmltools::p(tr("Each part keeps at least a quarter of its time free for getting there, breaks and surprises. Drag the ends of a day's white bar to change when you are free."))),
          htmltools::div(class = "days-actions",
            if (length(sugg)) htmltools::tags$button(class = "btn secondary", onclick = js_input("take_all", "all"),

        lapply(days, function(d) day_row(D, B, d, ws, parts, slots, walks, sugg, fits, sums, busy, pace)),
        htmltools::div(class = "days-key",

          htmltools::span(htmltools::tags$i(class = "k-handle"), tr("Drag to change the free time")),

        htmltools::p(class = "days-credit", tr("Walks: City of Melbourne Open Data, Self Guided Walks (CC BY), and team-made walks. Street band: City of Melbourne pedestrian counts near our places, average per weekday and hour, Oct 2025 to Oct 2026. Sunset: sunrise equation for the CBD. Steps and effort are estimates."))),
      pools$places))

name: R/planner.R
content:
# Trip planner: given a start point, a set of places, a day, a start time and a "back by" time,
# try every visiting order and score it. With at most 7 stops there are at most 5,040 orders,
# so checking all of them is exact and still takes well under a second.
#
# Times are minutes after midnight. Walking minutes come from the pre-computed Vicmap network
# (tools/04_build_walk_network.R) at 80 m/min; the pace setting rescales them.

MAX_STOPS <- 7

# Slack: a plan should leave at least a quarter of the free time (and at least 30 minutes) unplanned
# (not visiting or walking: waiting for a place to open counts as free), for queues, breaks, a coffee
# and surprises. Walks on the home page are only suggested if they leave it; a day plan with less is
# shown as "tight".
SLACK_SHARE <- 0.25
SLACK_MIN <- 30
slack_for <- function(len) pmax(SLACK_MIN, SLACK_SHARE * len)

PACES <- list(
  relaxed = list(label = "Relaxed", walk = 80 / 70, stay = 1.25),
  normal  = list(label = "Normal",  walk = 1,       stay = 1),
  brisk   = list(label = "Brisk",   walk = 80 / 90, stay = 0.75)
)

# Everything the planner needs about one free time `w` (a row of the free-time table): its day's
# opening hours, start and end points, times and street counts.
make_window_ctx <- function(D, w, pace = "normal") {
  d <- as.integer(format(w$date, "%u"))
  list(W = D$W, node_of_place = match(D$places$id, D$nodes),
       start = match(w$start, D$nodes), end = match(w$end, D$nodes),
       t0 = w$t0, deadline = w$t1, pace = pace,
       open = D$open[, d], close = D$close[, d], last_entry = D$last_entry,
       stay = D$places$stay_min, busy = D$busy[, d, ], sensor = D$places$sensor_id,
       day = d, start_id = w$start, end_id = w$end)
}

# All orderings of 1..n as rows of a matrix (cached, n <= MAX_STOPS).
perm_cache <- new.env()
permutations <- function(n) {
  key <- as.character(n)
  if (!is.null(perm_cache[[key]])) return(perm_cache[[key]])
  out <- if (n <= 1) matrix(1L, 1, 1) else {
    p <- permutations(n - 1)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) cbind(i, ifelse(p >= i, p + 1L, p))))
  }
  storage.mode(out) <- "integer"
  perm_cache[[key]] <- out
  out
}

# Evaluate many orders at once. `orders` is a matrix of place indices (one order per row).
# Returns a list of per-order vectors plus per-stop matrices (arrive, start, end, busy, problem).
evaluate_orders <- function(orders, ctx) {
  orders <- as.matrix(orders)
  n_ord <- nrow(orders); n <- ncol(orders)
  pace <- PACES[[ctx$pace]]
  t <- rep(ctx$t0, n_ord)
  prev <- rep(ctx$start, n_ord)
  walk_total <- rep(0, n_ord)
  arrive <- start <- end <- busy <- walk_in <- matrix(NA_real_, n_ord, n)
  problem <- matrix(0L, n_ord, n)      # 0 ok, 1 closed that day, 2 closes before the visit ends
  for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    s <- orders[, k]
    node <- ctx$node_of_place[s]
    w <- ctx$W[cbind(prev, node)] * pace$walk
    walk_in[, k] <- w
    walk_total <- walk_total + w
    t <- t + w
    arrive[, k] <- t
    o <- ctx$open[s]; cl <- ctx$close[s]; le <- ctx$last_entry[s]
    closed_today <- is.na(o)
    t <- ifelse(closed_today, t, pmax(t, o))                     # wait outside if early
    if (!is.null(ctx$not_before))                                # a walk picked for a later part of the day
      t <- ifelse(closed_today, t, pmax(t, ctx$not_before[s], na.rm = TRUE))
    start[, k] <- t
    stay <- ctx$stay[s] * pace$stay
    end[, k] <- t + stay
    late_entry <- !closed_today & !is.na(le) & t > le
    problem[, k] <- ifelse(closed_today, 1L, ifelse(late_entry | t + stay > cl, 2L, 0L))
    hr <- pmin(23L, as.integer(floor(t / 60)))
    busy[, k] <- ctx$busy[cbind(s, hr + 1L)]
    t <- t + stay
    prev <- node
  }
  w_back <- ctx$W[cbind(prev, rep(ctx$end, n_ord))] * pace$walk
  finish <- t + w_back
  list(orders = orders, arrive = arrive, start = start, end = end, busy = busy, walk_in = walk_in,
       problem = problem, walk_back = w_back, walk_total = walk_total + w_back, finish = finish,
       n_problems = rowSums(problem > 0), late = pmax(0, finish - ctx$deadline),
       busy_total = rowSums(busy, na.rm = TRUE))
}

pick_row <- function(ev, i) {
  list(order = ev$orders[i, ], arrive = ev$arrive[i, ], start = ev$start[i, ], end = ev$end[i, ],
       busy = ev$busy[i, ], walk_in = ev$walk_in[i, ], problem = ev$problem[i, ],
       walk_back = ev$walk_back[i], walk_total = ev$walk_total[i], finish = ev$finish[i],
       n_problems = ev$n_problems[i], late = ev$late[i], busy_total = ev$busy_total[i])
}

# Main entry: returns up to two options (shortest walk, quieter streets) and advice.
# groups (optional, one number per stop): only orders that visit the groups in increasing order are
# tried, e.g. the morning walk picked on the home page before the afternoon one. Stops with group NA
# (places the visitor added themselves) may go anywhere: every position is tried.
plan_trip <- function(sel, ctx, groups = NULL) {
  if (length(sel) == 0) return(NULL)
  sel <- head(sel, MAX_STOPS)
  perms <- permutations(length(sel))
  if (!is.null(groups)) {
    g <- matrix(head(groups, length(sel))[perms], ncol = length(sel))
    perms <- perms[apply(g, 1, function(r) !is.unsorted(r[!is.na(r)])), , drop = FALSE]
  }
  ev <- evaluate_orders(matrix(sel[perms], ncol = length(sel)), ctx)
  ok <- ev$n_problems == 0 & ev$late == 0
  # Shortest walk first among the orders with the fewest problems.
  rank_walk <- order(ev$n_problems, ev$late > 0, ev$late, ev$walk_total)
  shortest <- pick_row(ev, rank_walk[1])
  opts <- list(shortest = shortest)
  # Quieter streets: among orders that still work (or, if none work, among the best-ranked
  # ones), the one with the lowest total street count at arrival.
  pool <- if (any(ok)) which(ok) else which(ev$n_problems == ev$n_problems[rank_walk[1]] &
                                            ev$late <= ev$late[rank_walk[1]] + 1e-9)
  if (any(!is.na(ctx$sensor[sel])) && length(pool) > 1) {
    q <- pool[order(ev$busy_total[pool], ev$walk_total[pool])[1]]
    quiet <- pick_row(ev, q)
    saving <- 1 - quiet$busy_total / max(shortest$busy_total, 1)
    if (!identical(quiet$order, shortest$order) && saving >= 0.05) opts$quiet <- quiet
  }
  list(options = opts, feasible = any(ok), n_orders = nrow(ev$orders),
       drop_advice = if (!any(ok)) drop_advice(sel, ctx) else NULL)
}

# If nothing works, try leaving out each stop in turn.
drop_advice <- function(sel, ctx) {
  if (length(sel) < 2) return(NULL)
  out <- lapply(seq_along(sel), function(i) {
    rest <- sel[-i]
    ev <- evaluate_orders(matrix(rest[permutations(length(rest))], ncol = length(rest)), ctx)
    ok <- which(ev$n_problems == 0 & ev$late == 0)
    if (length(ok) == 0) return(NULL)
    b <- ok[which.min(ev$walk_total[ok])]
    data.frame(drop = sel[i], spare = ctx$deadline - ev$finish[b], walk = ev$walk_total[b])
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, out)
  if (is.null(out)) return(NULL)
  out[order(-out$spare), ]
}

# Places not yet chosen that would still fit into the chosen order without breaking anything.
what_fits <- function(opt, candidates, ctx) {
  if (is.null(opt) || opt$n_problems > 0 || opt$late > 0) return(NULL)
  ord <- opt$order
  rows <- lapply(candidates, function(q) {
    if (length(ord) >= MAX_STOPS) return(NULL)
    tries <- t(sapply(0:length(ord), function(p) append(ord, q, after = p)))
    ev <- evaluate_orders(tries, ctx)
    ok <- which(ev$n_problems == 0 & ev$late == 0)
    if (length(ok) == 0) return(NULL)
    b <- ok[which.min(ev$finish[ok])]
    data.frame(place = q, extra = ev$finish[b] - opt$finish, spare_after = ctx$deadline - ev$finish[b])
  })
  rows <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  if (is.null(rows)) return(NULL)
  rows[order(rows$extra), ]
}

# Can this one place be visited on its own and still be back in time?
fits_alone <- function(ctx) {
  ev <- evaluate_orders(matrix(seq_along(ctx$node_of_place), ncol = 1), ctx)
  ev$n_problems == 0 & ev$late == 0
}

# The time strip on each day of the home page (R/overview.R): sunset and how busy the city's streets
# are hour by hour on that weekday.

# Sunset (minutes after local midnight) by the sunrise equation (NOAA-style approximation, about a
# minute off at most: fine for a planning hint). Melbourne CBD.
sunset_min <- function(date, lat = -37.8136, lon = 144.9631, tz = "Australia/Melbourne") {
  rad <- pi / 180
  jd <- as.numeric(as.Date(date)) + 2440587.5 + 0.5
  n <- ceiling(jd - 2451545.0 + 0.0008)
  js <- n - lon / 360
  M <- (357.5291 + 0.98560028 * js) %% 360
  C <- 1.9148 * sin(M * rad) + 0.02 * sin(2 * M * rad) + 0.0003 * sin(3 * M * rad)
  lam <- (M + C + 180 + 102.9372) %% 360
  jt <- 2451545.0 + js + 0.0053 * sin(M * rad) - 0.0069 * sin(2 * lam * rad)
  dec <- asin(sin(lam * rad) * sin(23.4397 * rad))
  w0 <- acos((sin(-0.833 * rad) - sin(lat * rad) * sin(dec)) / (cos(lat * rad) * cos(dec))) / rad
  set <- as.POSIXct((jt + w0 / 360 - 2440587.5) * 86400, origin = "1970-01-01", tz = "UTC")
  lt <- as.POSIXlt(format(set, tz = tz, usetz = TRUE), tz = tz)
  lt$hour * 60 + lt$min + lt$sec / 60
}

# Street busyness by weekday x hour: mean over the places that have a sensor nearby, as levels 1-3
# (thirds of all 8-22 h values of the week, so the band compares hours with each other).
city_busy_levels <- function(D) {
  has <- which(!is.na(D$places$sensor_id))
  m <- apply(D$busy[has, , , drop = FALSE], c(2, 3), mean, na.rm = TRUE)   # 7 x 24
  cuts <- quantile(m[, 9:23], c(1 / 3, 2 / 3), na.rm = TRUE)
  lv <- matrix(1L + findInterval(m, cuts), 7, 24)
  list(level = lv, count = m)
}

# HTML pieces of the interface that are built from a plan. Class names follow the Figma design
# (01_分析与计划/Figma_design_prompt_2026-10-21.md and the Figma Make prototype built from it).

BUSY_COLS <- c("#FDE2C4", "#F59E4C", "#C2410C")   # sequential: quiet -> busy (single hue, colour-blind safe)
NO_DATA_COL <- "#E5E7EB"
busy_col <- function(level) ifelse(is.na(level), NO_DATA_COL, BUSY_COLS[pmax(1, pmin(3, level))])

fmt_count <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), tr("no sensor nearby"), sprintf(tr("%s people/h"), format(round(x, -1), big.mark = ",")))

js_input <- function(name, value) sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('%s', '%s', {priority: 'event'})", name, value)

ICON <- list(   # small line icons used in the Figma design
  calendar = htmltools::HTML('<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="16" rx="3"/><path d="M8 3v4M16 3v4M3 10h18"/></svg>'),

  gear = htmltools::HTML('<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12.22 2h-.44a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v.18a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.73l-.43.25a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-.15-.08a2 2 0 0 0-2.73.73l-.22.38a2 2 0 0 0 .73 2.73l.15.1a2 2 0 0 1 1 1.72v.51a2 2 0 0 1-1 1.74l-.15.09a2 2 0 0 0-.73 2.73l.22.38a2 2 0 0 0 2.73.73l.15-.08a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l.43.25a2 2 0 0 1 1 1.73V20a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h.44a2 2 0 0 0 2-2v-.18a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.73l.43-.25a2 2 0 0 1 2 0l.15.08a2 2 0 0 0 2.73-.73l.22-.39a2 2 0 0 0-.73-2.73l-.15-.08a2 2 0 0 1-1-1.74v-.5a2 2 0 0 1 1-1.74l.15-.09a2 2 0 0 0 .73-2.73l-.22-.38a2 2 0 0 0-2.73-.73l-.15.08a2 2 0 0 1-2 0l-.43-.25a2 2 0 0 1-1-1.73V4a2 2 0 0 0-2-2z"/><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"/></svg>'))

# Small plain <select> for changing one field of a free time in place (the free-time list).
# `choices` is a vector (value = label) or a named list of named vectors (option groups).
edit_select <- function(id, field, choices, selected) {
  opts <- function(v) {
    lab <- if (is.null(names(v))) v else names(v)
    lapply(seq_along(v), function(i) htmltools::tags$option(value = v[[i]], selected = if (identical(unname(v[[i]]), selected)) NA, lab[i]))
  }
  body <- if (is.list(choices)) lapply(names(choices), function(g) htmltools::tags$optgroup(label = g, opts(choices[[g]]))) else opts(choices)
  htmltools::tags$select(class = "inline-select",
    onchange = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('edit_window', {id: '%s', field: '%s', value: this.value}, {priority: 'event'})", id, field),
    body)
}

# About a place, shown as a popup on the map for the place clicked (its i in the list, its marker or its
# row in the plan): what it is, how long and how tiring a visit is (R/effort.R), when it is open that
# day, the quietest hour to arrive within this free time, and add / remove.
place_card <- function(i, D, ctx, in_plan, stop_no = NA, pace = "normal") {
  p <- D$places[i, ]
  o <- ctx$open[i]; cl <- ctx$close[i]
  hours_line <- if (is.na(o)) htmltools::span(class = "closed-text", sprintf(tr("Closed on %s"), day_name(ctx$day)))
                else sprintf("%s %s", day_name(ctx$day), hours_text(o, cl))
  # quietest hour to arrive while the place is open inside this free time
  h0 <- if (is.na(o)) 1 else ceiling(max(ctx$t0, o) / 60)
  h1 <- if (is.na(o)) 0 else floor((min(ctx$deadline, cl) - 1) / 60)
  hrs <- if (h1 >= h0) h0:min(h1, 23) else integer()
  v <- if (length(hrs) && !is.na(p$sensor_id)) ctx$busy[i, hrs + 1] else NA
  best <- if (all(is.na(v))) NULL else htmltools::tags$b(sprintf(tr(" · Quietest around %02d:00"), hrs[which.min(v)]))
  htmltools::div(class = "place-card",
    htmltools::div(class = "place-body",
      htmltools::p(class = "eyebrow", paste0(tr(p$category), if (!is.na(stop_no)) sprintf(tr(" · Stop %d"), stop_no))),
      htmltools::h2(place_name(D, i)),
      # "About %1$s" (same English as "About %s") keeps the duration apart from app.R's "About <place>"
      htmltools::div(class = "tags",
        htmltools::span(tr(tools::toTitleCase(p$setting))), htmltools::span(tr(tools::toTitleCase(p$entry))),
        htmltools::span(sprintf(tr("About %1$s"), fmt_dur(p$stay_min * PACES[[pace]]$stay)))),
      htmltools::p(class = "place-effort", effort_tag(inside_m(D, i, pace) / 1000 * STEPS_PER_KM, "place")),
      htmltools::p(hours_line, best),
      htmltools::div(class = "card-actions",
        if (!is.na(p$official_url) && nzchar(p$official_url))
          htmltools::a(class = "btn secondary", href = p$official_url, target = "_blank", tr("Official site ↗")),
        htmltools::tags$button(class = paste("btn", if (in_plan) "secondary danger" else "primary"),
                               onclick = js_input("toggle_place", p$id),
                               if (in_plan) tr("Remove") else tr("Add to this day")))))
}

# Why place i cannot be visited on its own in this free time (for the place list), "" if it can:
# closed that day, closing (or last entry) before you could get there and stay, or too far to be back.
unfit_reason <- function(D, i, ctx) {
  o <- ctx$open[i]
  if (is.na(o)) return(sprintf(tr("closed %s"), day_name(ctx$day, "short")))
  pace <- PACES[[ctx$pace]]
  start <- max(ctx$t0 + ctx$W[ctx$start, ctx$node_of_place[i]] * pace$walk, o)
  le <- ctx$last_entry[i]
  if (start + ctx$stay[i] * pace$stay > ctx$close[i] || (!is.na(le) && start > le))
    return(if (start < o + 1 && ctx$close[i] - o < ctx$stay[i] * pace$stay) tr("not open long enough")
           else sprintf(tr("closes %s"), fmt_time(ctx$close[i])))
  tr("too far")
}

# Stand-in for the Tableau view while it is not published: day x hour grid of the average street
# count near the ticked places, in the same quiet / moderate / busy classes as the map. Clicking a
# cell sends the same `quiet_pick` input as the Tableau mark-selection handler.
quiet_heatmap <- function(idx, D) {
  idx <- idx[!is.na(D$places$sensor_id[idx])]
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(htmltools::p(class = "heat-credit", tr("Plan places with a pedestrian sensor nearby to see when their streets are quiet.")))
  hours <- 6:22
  m <- sapply(hours, function(h) sapply(1:7, function(d) mean(D$busy[idx, d, h + 1], na.rm = TRUE)))
  cols <- sprintf("grid-template-columns: 54px repeat(%d, 1fr)", length(hours))
  htmltools::div(class = "overview-heatmap",
    htmltools::div(class = "heat-hours", style = cols, htmltools::span(""),
                   lapply(hours, function(h) htmltools::span(sprintf("%02d", h)))),
    lapply(1:7, function(d) htmltools::div(class = "heat-row", style = cols,
      htmltools::strong(day_name(d, "short")),
      lapply(seq_along(hours), function(j) htmltools::tags$button(
        class = paste0("lv", busy_level(m[d, j], D$busy_cuts)),
        title = paste0(sprintf(tr("%s %02d:00 · about %s people per hour near your places"),
                               day_name(d), hours[j], format(round(m[d, j], -1), big.mark = ",")),
                       "\n", tr("Click to start that free time at this hour")),
        onclick = sprintf("Shiny.setInputValue('quiet_pick', {day: %d, hour: %d}, {priority: 'event'})", d, hours[j]))))),
    htmltools::p(class = "heat-credit", tr("Preview drawn in R; the published Tableau view shows the same data and works the same way.")))
}

option_card <- function(key, opt, ctx, ref = NULL, selected = FALSE) {
  title <- c(shortest = tr("Shortest walk"), quiet = tr("Quieter streets"))[[key]]
  spare <- ctx$deadline - opt$finish
  tag <- if (key == "shortest") tr("Fewest minutes") else if (!is.null(ref) && ref$busy_total > 0)
    sprintf(tr("%+d%% people"), round(100 * (opt$busy_total / ref$busy_total - 1)))
  detail <- if (opt$n_problems > 0) sprintf(tr("%d stop(s) closed or closing"), opt$n_problems)
            else sprintf(if (spare >= 0) tr("%s walking · %s spare") else tr("%s walking · %s late"),
                         fmt_dur(opt$walk_total), fmt_dur(abs(spare)))
  htmltools::tags$button(
    class = paste(if (selected) "selected", if (opt$n_problems > 0 || spare < 0) "bad"),
    onclick = js_input("option", key),
    htmltools::span(htmltools::strong(title), if (!is.null(tag)) htmltools::tags$i(tag)),
    htmltools::tags$b(fmt_time(opt$finish)),
    htmltools::tags$small(paste(tr("Back time ·"), detail)))
}

# "Your day": one row per stop (time, number coloured by street busyness, place, stay, walk on),
# starting where the visitor leaves from and ending back at the end point with the spare time.
# When the plan runs over more than one part of the day, each part (morning, afternoon, evening)
# gets a heading, so the day reads as a few big blocks. `rest` (optional) adds the rest at the place
# they are staying before setting off; `effort` (outing_effort) adds the time on the go and steps.
itinerary_html <- function(opt, ctx, D, start_name, end_name, rest = NULL, effort = NULL) {
  n <- length(opt$order)
  walk_next <- c(opt$walk_in[-1], opt$walk_back)
  rows <- list()
  if (!is.null(rest)) rows[[1]] <- htmltools::tags$button(class = "rest-row",
    htmltools::tags$time(fmt_time(rest$from_time)), htmltools::tags$i("☕"),
    htmltools::span(htmltools::strong(sprintf(tr("Rest at %s"), start_name)),
      htmltools::tags$small(if (rest$walk > 0.5) sprintf(tr("%s · walk %s there from %s"), fmt_dur(rest$minutes), fmt_dur(rest$walk), rest$from)
                            else fmt_dur(rest$minutes))))
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::tags$button(class = "start",
    htmltools::tags$time(fmt_time(ctx$t0)), htmltools::tags$i(""),
    htmltools::span(htmltools::strong(start_name), htmltools::tags$small(tr("Leave")),
                    htmltools::tags$em(sprintf(tr("Walk %s"), fmt_dur(opt$walk_in[1])))))
  part_no <- part_of(opt$start)
  for (k in seq_len(n)) {
    if (length(unique(part_no)) > 1 && (k == 1 || part_no[k] != part_no[k - 1]))
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::div(class = "part-row", tr(PARTS$label[part_no[k]]))
    i <- opt$order[k]; p <- D$places[i, ]
    lv <- busy_level(opt$busy[k], D$busy_cuts)
    note <- c(
      if (opt$start[k] > opt$arrive[k] + 0.5) {
        planned <- !is.null(ctx$not_before) && !is.na(ctx$not_before[i]) && abs(opt$start[k] - ctx$not_before[i]) < 0.5
        sprintf(if (planned) tr("%s free before this part of the day starts") else tr("wait %s for opening"), fmt_dur(opt$start[k] - opt$arrive[k]))
      },
      if (opt$problem[k] == 1) tr("closed today"),
      if (opt$problem[k] == 2) sprintf(tr("closes %s"), fmt_time(ctx$close[i])))
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::tags$button(
      class = if (opt$problem[k] > 0) "bad", `data-place` = p$id, onclick = js_input("focus_place", p$id),
      htmltools::tags$time(fmt_time(opt$start[k])),
      htmltools::tags$i(style = sprintf("background:%s; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px %s;%s", busy_col(lv), busy_col(lv),
                                        if (!is.na(lv) && lv == 3) " color:#fff;" else ""), k),
      htmltools::span(htmltools::strong(place_name(D, i)),
        htmltools::tags$small(sprintf("%s · %s", fmt_dur(opt$end[k] - opt$start[k]),
                                      ifelse(is.na(lv), tr("no street count"), tr(BUSY_LABELS[lv])))),
        if (length(note)) htmltools::tags$small(class = "note", paste(note, collapse = tr(", "))),
        htmltools::tags$em(sprintf(tr("Walk %s"), fmt_dur(walk_next[k])))))
  }
  spare <- ctx$deadline - opt$finish
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- htmltools::tags$button(class = "back",
    htmltools::tags$time(fmt_time(opt$finish)), htmltools::tags$i(class = if (spare >= 0) "done" else "late", if (spare >= 0) "✓" else "!"),
    htmltools::span(htmltools::strong(end_name),
                    htmltools::tags$small(sprintf(if (spare >= 0) tr("Back · %s spare") else tr("Back · %s late"), fmt_dur(abs(spare))))))
  htmltools::tagList(
    htmltools::div(class = "itinerary-head", htmltools::h3(tr("Your day")),
      htmltools::span(sprintf(tr("%d place%s%s"), n, pl(n),
                              if (!is.null(effort)) sprintf(tr(" · %s on the go"), fmt_dur(effort$minutes)) else ""))),
    if (!is.null(effort)) htmltools::div(class = "itinerary-effort", effort_tag(effort$steps, what = tr("from your start, the stops and back"))),
    htmltools::div(class = "itinerary", rows))
}
